text:
Evan: hi all, i'm Evan — first-week question. i can edit flags in staging but the Admin > Feature Flags tab is missing in prod Console. i need to enable beta_search_experiment at 10% for a 10m smoke. who do i ask for access?
Jules: welcome Evan! :wave: Prod flag writes go through the privileged-action flow. can you open a PRIV ticket with dashboards + rollback steps? we usually approve small, timeboxed toggles same-day.
Evan: opened PRIV-2077 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRIV-2077 "temp prod toggle beta_search_experiment 10% (10m)" — added Grafana links and the revert plan.
Samir: quick note: prefer using the Console "scheduled toggle" UI for short tests (it auto-adds audit metadata). if you already created the ticket that's fine, infra can do a temp grant.
security-bot: PRIV checklist: 1) description 2) dashboards 3) rollback steps 4) pager contacts. recommended TTL <=30m; max 2h. link: https://docs.redwood.ai/security/privileged-actions
Jules: i've reviewed and approve PRIV-2077. tagging infra for a temporary grant with a 20m TTL (buffer).
infra-bot: initiating grant: `grant-temp --user=evan --role=console-admin --env=prod --ttl=00:20 --ticket=PRIV-2077 --note="first-week smoke"`
infra-bot: grant complete. audit_id=aud-77a9de. expires in 20m. :white_check_mark:
Evan: used the Console scheduled toggle to set 10% for 10m. smoke ran — checks look green. reverting to 0% now. curl reference for future: `curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.ai/api/flags/schedule" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"flag":"beta_search_experiment","pct":10,"duration_mins":10}'`
Jules: thanks — added a line to onboarding: "If you need prod flag edits, file PRIV ticket on day 0 and include dashboards" to avoid delays.
Samir: i'll add a short note in the platform runbook linking PRIV-2077 for traceability.
Evan: awesome, appreciate the quick help — made my first-week checklist item! :smile:
